{{Quote|<nowiki></nowiki>''Chinnith'' to ''Anakin Solo''. You'll never guess who I just shot.|The Chev pilot contacts the ''Anakin Solo'' after the incident|<ref name="Fury" />}}
The '''''Chinnith''''' was a [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Troop/Legends|troop]] [[Carrier/Legends|carrier]] [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] that docked to the [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]] [[Centerpoint Station]] during a [[Battle of Centerpoint Station (Second Galactic Civil War)|battle]] there in [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]], amidst the [[Second Galactic Civil War]]. When [[Five World Prime Minister]] [[Sadras Koyan]] of the [[Confederation]] accidentally boarded the shuttle while looking for a way to get off the [[Space station/Legends|station]], he encountered the [[Chev]] [[Unidentified Chev|pilot]] of the ''Chinnith'', who shot and [[Death/Legends|killed]] him before Koyan could fire with his own [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]].

==Description==
The ''Chinnith'' was a [[Realspace/Legends|space]]-capable [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] that was equipped to serve as a [[Troop/Legends|troop]] [[Carrier/Legends|carrier]]. It possessed a main cabin and a [[Cockpit/Legends|cockpit]], which had at least one seat for a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]]. The ''Chinnith'' also had [[Engine/Legends|engines]] and was equipped with [[Life support/Legends|life support]] for the occupants.<ref name="Fury" />

==History==
{{Quote|Hello?''"<br />"''Yes?''"<br />"''Get me to Coronet immediately.|Sadras Koyan mistakes the ''Chinnith'' for a Confederate shuttle and asks the Chev pilot for transportation|<ref name="Fury" />}}
By [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]],<ref name="Fury" /><ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> during the [[Second Galactic Civil War]], which saw the [[Confederation]] in conflict with the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]], the ''Chinnith'' was in service with the Galactic Alliance's [[Galactic Alliance Defense Fleet|navy]]. That [[Standard year/Legends|year]], the Galactic Alliance launched a [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] [[Space warfare/Legends|operation]] to [[Battle of Centerpoint Station (Second Galactic Civil War)|seize control]] of the [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]] [[Centerpoint Station]] in the [[Corellian system/Legends|Corellian system]] from the Confederation, and the ''Chinnith'' took part, with a [[Chev]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Unidentified Chev|pilot]] as one of the crew. During the fighting, the Galactic Alliance used troop shuttles to land [[Galactic Alliance Guard]]s and other [[Commando/Legends|commandos]] onto Centerpoint Station.<ref name="Fury" />

Following the boarding, the ''Chinnith'' was attached to Centerpoint Station's [[Airlock/Legends|Air Lock]] Epsilon Thirty-four G, with the Chev pilot still aboard. After being duped into thinking a Confederate shuttle was at Air Lock Epsilon Thirty-four G by [[Denjax Teppler]], his [[Minister of Information (Five Worlds)|Minister of Information]], [[Five World Prime Minister]] [[Sadras Koyan]] entered the ''Chinnith'' in a bid to get off Centerpoint Station as he fled from the Galactic Alliance forces on the superweapon. Demanding transportation to [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] as he entered the shuttle, Koyan came face-to-face with the Chev, with both realizing that they were on opposite sides of the battle. The Chev [[Officer/Legends|officer]] was able to draw her [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] first, shooting and [[Death/Legends|killing]] Koyan in the ''Chinnith'', before she contacted the Galactic Alliance [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial II''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Anakin Solo (starship)|''Anakin Solo'']] to report the incident. The ''Chinnith'' later departed the [[Space station/Legends|station]] with Koyan's body. The battle ended when Centerpoint Station was destroyed due to [[Saboteur/Legends|sabotage]] by the [[Jedi Coalition]], taking with it large portions of both the Galactic Alliance and Confederate fleets in the resulting explosion.<ref name="Fury" />

==Commanders and crew==
{{Quote|Kork. Forgot to set it to stun.|The Chev pilot, after shooting Sadras Koyan dead|<ref name="Fury" />}}
During the fighting for Centerpoint Station, a Galactic Alliance Chev officer served as a pilot for the ''Chinnith''.<ref name="Fury" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Chinnith'' appeared in [[2007]]'s ''[[Legacy of the Force: Fury]]'', by [[Aaron Allston]]. The novel did not specifically state that the ''Chinnith'' was used to land troops on Centerpoint Station nor if the shuttle survived the station's explosion.
